patch_list: Get your ad rewards for free. Every "watch ad" button gives you the reward right away — no ad to sit through, no waiting.
Everything in the shop is free. Tap an item and you get it instantly — no paying, no waiting, no Google Play involved.
Free coins forever. Your point balance always reads as the maximum, so you can afford anything in the shop. You can still spend and save normally.
